cv_note: control noise 2% of mean SNR; lower RMSE = better; K=256 means all 256 nodes (16x16).

variance_coverage_idw_p2_K16.note: empirical variance of the LINEAR estimator is exactly w^T Var w when the control values are the only noise source; deviations are MC noise only.

clamp_checkerboard.note: IDW min prediction >= control min (convex, no clamp needed); the spline class undershoots below the control minimum => clamp to [min,max] of control values is required for spline operators (repo P-ALG-09), while for IDW the clamp is a no-op by construction.
